kind: Explicit OpenPGP signer enrollment, exact detached signature intake and current release gate

candidate.committed_source_verification: All 112 source file SHA-256 values match the Git blobs of this local commit; original raw evidence is preserved.

environment.postgresql: 16.15 retained task-owned loopback Docker fixture; non-owner runtime without BYPASSRLS, plus isolated disposable real databases for transaction/migration cases
environment.receiver: Native stock OpenSSH 10.5p1, separate daemon/filesystem on this macOS host
clients: stock curl with explicit fixture TLS trust
stock OpenSSH sftp with pinned host and explicit key
native freightctl CLI sharing HTTPS services
environment.assistance: Agent-created synthetic fixture and automated steps; no independent operator adoption
environment.model: No inference; local model starts, loads, warmups and evaluations remain disallowed.

cryptography.licenses: Both BSD-3-Clause; exact license files retained in checksum-verified module cache. No distribution is performed.
peer_profiles: v4 Ed25519 primary plus Ed25519 signing subkey/SHA256
cryptography.v6: Library/unit verification and bounded parsing only; no independent v6 peer result.

first_failures.result: pgp-key-register was unknown on the starting commit. The original command now enrolls an exact fingerprint; stock clients exercise held signed intake/restart, release, receiver retrieval, independent GnuPG verification, invalid-signature denial, revocation and explicit RSA policy selection.

mechanisms: Public-only bounded packet admission and maintained in-process library under internal/crypto. No private signing/decryption key, GnuPG process, network key fetch or UID-based trust in production.
Immutable primary-fingerprint key versions and policy/source/storage-bound actor-private sidecar references. Sync before attachment event/receipt; failed receipt retains only observable orphan bytes.
Missing signature spends zero attempts. Exact CSV plus detached binary-signature proof is required, and a pass stays held until separate exact report/revision-bound approval.
Release re-verifies actual source/signature and current key/policy/authority; SQL event/projection/release guards require corresponding signer proof.
Controlled-file availability includes active key and proof expiry. Real open readers stop after key revocation. Existing integrity-only revisions retain original scope.
Same existing two check slots, three attempts, fenced 70-second lease and bounded streaming; no source-sized buffer. No new inference or transfer worker pool.
Version overlap is explicit: enrolling a new key version leaves previous versions active until separately revoked. Policies cannot silently rebind old jobs.
Real PostgreSQL tests cover actor privacy, immutable key/signature rows, signature corruption at release and transactional receipt failure with retained orphan evidence.

migration_notes.existing_grants: Unchanged. V1 upgrade rejects implicit pgp_manage; new development administrators get nineteen explicit grants.
migration_notes.application_database: PostgreSQL only. Independent GnuPG image has a transitive sqlite library, but its ephemeral flat keyring uses no keyboxd; application imports/storage add no SQLite or Redis.

govulncheck.conclusion: The native source scan retains GO-2026-5932 as a module-only advisory for unimported golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp packages. No affected package is imported and no reachable symbol is reported. The new ProtonMail backend uses its separate maintained module. This is not a zero-advisory or all-platform release claim.

gitleaks.required_result: Final source and reachable history must both pass with empty reports; history is scanned again after the local commit.
gitleaks.scope: Regular tracked/unignored source and reachable history. Secrets, synthetic private key packets, models, payloads, database files and raw evidence remain ignored.
gitleaks.native_result_note: Pinned final source/history scans and post-commit history verification are retained at the manifest reference.

limits: Detached binary-document signature plus CSV gate; encryption, malware scanning, attached/cleartext/text-canonicalized signatures and complete business acknowledgment remain required.
Independent GnuPG 2.4.9 Linux aarch64 fixture is capped at 128 MiB/one CPU with network disabled; this is not native Linux application qualification.
V4 Ed25519 primary/signing subkey and RSA3072/SHA256 peer profiles. V6 has library/unit coverage, not independent peer qualification.
Explicit fingerprint enrollment, actor-owned jobs and bounded files; KMS/HSM, private signing/decryption, delegated review, broader peers/algorithms and full journeys remain open.
Historical integrity-only revisions retain their original scope; no retroactive cryptographic verdict is claimed.
Assisted same-host loopback exercise, not production performance, HA, independent adoption or enterprise/release qualification.

Actor-owned check/release and partner public key administration only. Human trust onboarding, delegated reviewers, re-scan/rebind, exceptions, automatic checks, UI, protected retention and cleanup remain required.

Public wire 32 KiB / decoded 16 KiB, one primary, eight subkeys/UIDs, 64 definite packets and one detached binary-document signature. Admission is broader than the independently tested algorithm profiles.
No FIPS/HSM/KMS, broad cryptographic profile, native Linux/Windows application, multi-host resilience, performance/endurance or offline release qualification.
All 83 parity rows and 12 complete journeys remain open. Two private-model profiles and held-out evaluation thresholds remain open under X05; no model was run.
